=== POST owners yml ===
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Normalize the telephone (strip non-digits, require exactly 10) first: it is the sole
# @RequestBody binding and must run before the DTO's digits-only pattern check would reject
# the raw input. It publishes the normalized body for the validate step.
normalize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

# Normalize the optional email (validate its format when present, then lower-case it) on the
# already-bound body, before validation and any persistence.
normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: validateEmailDomain

# Reject an owner whose (now normalized) email domain is on the disposable-domain blocklist
# with a 400, before validation and any persistence. An absent email is skipped.
validateEmailDomain:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerEmailDomain
  next: normalizeAddress

# Normalize the address (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand abbreviations) on the
# already-bound body, before validation. Running before validate means an address blank once
# normalized is rejected as a missing required field, and every later address comparison
# (duplicate household, shared household id) sees the normalized form.
normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  next: validate

# Validate so a missing/blank required field is a 400 listing those fields, before any
# entity is built or persisted.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the optional postcode when present: it must be valid for the city's region per the
# fixed ranges, else a 400. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode; an absent
# postcode is skipped. Runs after field validation (which enforces the 4-digit format) and
# before any entity is built or persisted.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server's current date with a 400, before
# any entity is built or persisted. An absent date is left to default downstream. Runs after
# the other field validations and before the date is resolved (weekend-adjusted).
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate
  next: unique

# Reject a request that would add a second owner to an existing household (same computed
# household id, i.e. same lastName + postcode) with a 409, before any entity is built or
# persisted. A request declaring 'sharesHousehold' bypasses this block and is created as a
# household member. Reads the same transaction as the writes.
unique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: cityCapacity

# Reject the request with a 409 when its city already holds the maximum number of owners,
# before any entity is built or persisted. Reads the count in the same transaction as the
# writes so the per-city cap is enforced consistently.
cityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityHasCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: resolveRegistrationDate

# Resolve the effective registration date (supplied date, else the server's current date)
# and roll a weekend forward to the next Monday, before the daily-capacity check counts
# against it and before the owner is built. Publishes the adjusted date for both.
resolveRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveOwnerRegistrationDate
  next: dailyCapacity

# Reject the request with a 429 once the resolved business day (by adjusted registrationDate)
# already holds the maximum number of owner registrations, before any entity is built or
# persisted. Reads the count in the same transaction as the writes so the per-day limit is
# enforced consistently.
dailyCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyOwnerCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Stamp the deterministic household id (first 12 hex of SHA-256 of lastName + postcode) onto the
# built owner, so every owner sharing a lastName and postcode gets the same id automatically.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

# Record the size of this owner's household once the create completes (existing members
# sharing its household id plus the owner itself). Runs after the household id is assigned,
# before the new owner is persisted, so the count reflects the state after the create without
# counting the owner twice.
assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

# Record how many existing owners already shared this owner's firstName and lastName
# (case-insensitively) before this create. Reads the count in the same transaction as the
# write, before the new owner is persisted so it is not counted against itself.
assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipPoints

# Score the built owner's membership points from its email, namesake count, household size and
# tenure: start at 0, +2 for an email, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or
# more, +3 when tenure exceeds 365 days. A newly registered owner has zero tenure, so a new owner
# never earns the tenure points. Runs after the household size and namesake count are recorded and
# before the owner is persisted, so the points are final.
assignMembershipPoints:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMembershipPoints
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipLevel

# Derive the numeric membership level from the points just scored: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3,
# 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more. Runs after the points are recorded and before the owner is
# persisted, so the level and the audit line reflect the final values.
assignMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

# Flag the built owner when more than 80 owners were already created for its resolved
# registration day. Reads the count in the same transaction as the write, before the new
# owner is persisted so it is not counted against itself.
assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Flag the built owner as a soft duplicate when an existing owner shares its lastName and
# postcode but has a different telephone (not a hard household duplicate, which is rejected
# upstream). A declared household member ('sharesHousehold') is never flagged. Reads existing
# owners in the same transaction as the write, before the new owner is persisted so it is not
# matched against itself.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: applyRegistrationDate

# Stamp the resolved (weekend-adjusted) registration date onto the built owner before it is
# persisted, so it and every value derived from it use the adjusted business day.
applyRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ApplyOwnerRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code: the owner's region (derived from its postcode)
# joined to the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName).
# Deterministic from the owner's identity, so no sequence number and no count to read.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT log line for the successful create, carrying the persisted owner id, its
# customerCode and registrationDate. Runs after save so the generated id is available.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

load:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, normalized like
            'address'. When present it is appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form
            the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The owner's postal address. Accepted as a flat string for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this becomes the
            composed, normalized address ('addressLine1' plus a space and 'addressLine2' when
            present). Stored and returned in normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner, stored in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 9
          maxLength: 16
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the
            owner's city, i.e. within the inclusive range of the city's region (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-18'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied it
            is stored and returned, and the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, declares this owner a member of an existing household and bypasses the
            duplicate block, permitting creation even though another owner shares the same
            lastName and postcode. Such a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for people to read: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits in space-separated groups of three.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION segment of the owner's customerCode: the canonical region the code was
                built from (derived from the postcode range first, falling back to the fixed
                city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred way to reach the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only
                when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Server-assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName). Deterministic from the
                owner's region and identity, with no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName +
                '|' + postcode). Assigned to every owner, so any two owners with the same lastName
                and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '9f2c1a...'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating telephone, email
                and household: 'normalizedTelephone|email-or-empty|householdId-or-empty'. Two
                owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Membership number derived as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership score assigned at creation, starting at 0: +2 when an email is
                present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, and +3 when
                tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level assigned at creation, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration day at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, another owner already shared this owner's lastName
                and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match), otherwise false. An
                owner created as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is never
                flagged.
              type: boolean

              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-

                at creation. Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional courtesy title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When supplied it
            prefixes the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, normalized like
            'address'. When present it is appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form
            the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The owner's postal address. Accepted as a flat string for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this becomes the
            composed, normalized address ('addressLine1' plus a space and 'addressLine2' when
            present). Stored and returned in normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner, stored in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 9
          maxLength: 16
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the
            owner's city, i.e. within the inclusive range of the city's region (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-18'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied it
            is stored and returned, and the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, declares this owner a member of an existing household and bypasses the
            duplicate block, permitting creation even though another owner shares the same
            lastName and postcode. Such a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for people to read: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits in space-separated groups of three.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION segment of the owner's customerCode: the canonical region the code was
                built from (derived from the postcode range first, falling back to the fixed
                city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred way to reach the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only
                when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Server-assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName). Deterministic from the
                owner's region and identity, with no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName +
                '|' + postcode). Assigned to every owner, so any two owners with the same lastName
                and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '9f2c1a...'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating telephone, email
                and household: 'normalizedTelephone|email-or-empty|householdId-or-empty'. Two
                owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Membership number derived as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership score assigned at creation, starting at 0: +2 when an email is
                present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, and +3 when
                tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level assigned at creation, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration day at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, another owner already shared this owner's lastName
                and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match), otherwise false. An
                owner created as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is never

              type: boolean

              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional courtesy title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When supplied it
            prefixes the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, normalized like
            'address'. When present it is appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form
            the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The owner's postal address. Accepted as a flat string for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this becomes the
            composed, normalized address ('addressLine1' plus a space and 'addressLine2' when
            present). Stored and returned in normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner, stored in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 9
          maxLength: 16
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the
            owner's city, i.e. within the inclusive range of the city's region (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-18'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied it
            is stored and returned, and the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, declares this owner a member of an existing household and bypasses the
            duplicate block, permitting creation even though another owner shares the same
            lastName and postcode. Such a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for people to read: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits in space-separated groups of three.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION segment of the owner's customerCode: the canonical region the code was
                built from (derived from the postcode range first, falling back to the fixed
                city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred way to reach the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only
                when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Server-assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName). Deterministic from the
                owner's region and identity, with no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName +
                '|' + postcode). Assigned to every owner, so any two owners with the same lastName
                and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '9f2c1a...'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating telephone, email
                and household: 'normalizedTelephone|email-or-empty|householdId-or-empty'. Two
                owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
